# OA Group Nigeria — Comprehensive LLM Reference

## Identity
Brand: OA Group Nigeria
Website: https://www.oagroupng.com/
Tagline: Integrated Expertise · Trusted Solutions · Sustainable Growth
Master proposition: A diversified Nigerian business group delivering professional, financial, property, advisory and commercial solutions through a portfolio of specialist companies.

## Digital architecture
The group parent is the institutional intelligence layer. The five operating companies are independent specialist businesses with their own propositions, clients, technical expertise, service portfolios and regulatory identities.

## Companies
1. Olusola Adekanola & Co — audit, accounting, internal audit, tax, risk, controls, compliance, company secretariat and insolvency-related services. Positioning: Compliance. Accuracy. Confidence. Established 1984 per supplied specification; professional affiliations should be published exactly as verified.
2. OA Consulting Limited — business advisory, revenue generation and recovery, management consulting, M&A advisory, procurement management, process optimisation, debt recovery, training and capacity development.
3. Henrisol Properties Ltd — real estate investment, property development, property management, facilities management, land and housing, sales and lettings. Diaspora audience includes Nigerians in UK, US and Canada.
4. Maria Oyinlola Limited — credit and lending, financial advisory, investment and asset management, digital financing, payment distribution, agency banking, corporate finance and institutional finance. Regulatory statements must use current verified licence information.
5. Pearl Primus Multipurpose Contracting Limited — contract administration, project facilitation, investment management and commercial ventures. BPP language should be specific and verified.
